title: Syrian Flatbread with Caramelized Onion and Thyme
description: A French-inspired flatbread topped with caramelized onions and thyme, perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the pastry to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the pastry with olive oil and sprinkle with salt.
Caramelize the sliced onions in a skillet over medium heat for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle the cooked onions over the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top the onions with the chopped thyme and crushed flatbread crumbs.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
